name: spec-bridge
description: SpecBridge: translates business needs into deployable, acceptance-ready product specs for vibe-coding — requirement interrogation, user stories, priorities, UI inference, milestones.

displayDescription.en: Translates business language into developable, acceptance-ready product specs: requirement interrogation, user story breakdown, priority ranking, UI inference and milestone definition.
displayDescription.zh: 把业务语言翻译成可开发、可验收的产品规格：需求拷问、用户故事、优先级、界面推理与里程碑定义。
